questions.title: TestManageTenantIndices root cause — source bug or mock issue?
questions.canonical_fix: autouse mock_rag_dependencies fixture in test_rag_tenant_management.py: monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, faiss+sentence_transformers) + setattr(_indexer, faiss) + setattr(_model_utils, safe_load_sentence_transformer). Root cause: faiss=None at module level + sentence_transformers import inside function + bare except swallowing errors => success=False.

questions.title: IncrementalSyncDecider test_micro_update 95% change ratio for punctuation edit
questions.canonical_fix: SequenceMatcher(autojunk=False) in content_diff.py (Option A from deep research plan). autojunk=True causes 95% false change ratio on repeated strings. autojunk=False already present at line 232. Test updated to use non-repetitive natural text as defence-in-depth.

questions.title: Multi-output CLI JSON testing pattern
questions.canonical_fix: CliRunner(mix_stderr=False) + result.stdout for JSON + result.stderr for provenance. Confirmed by deep research (comment-3942086106).

questions.title: audit_runner.py full vs minimal output environment flags
questions.canonical_fix: importlib.util.find_spec skipif guard in test_audit_pipeline.py. Root cause: audit_runner gracefully degrades when sub-scanners not on PYTHONPATH, writing minimal manifest. Tests skip when 'version' key absent.

questions.title: Pytest string-path monkeypatch fails in CI
questions.canonical_fix: Object-based monkeypatch.setattr(module_obj, attr, value). Documented in CODEBASE_AGENCY_POLICY.md. Root cause: pytest 8.x derive_importpath fails when sub-module not fully bound in sys.modules during parallel/random test execution.

questions.title: OptimizedVectorStore ResponseCache does not persist search results
questions.canonical_fix: All `if self.cache:` changed to `if self.cache is not None:` in optimizations.py. Root cause: ResponseCache.__len__==0 when empty makes bool(cache)==False, skipping both .get() and .put() on every search call.
